newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION - Cullen unlikely to play Super 12 opener.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION - Cullen unlikely to play Super 12 opener.

text.p: PALMERSTON NORTH, Feb 25 - Four days from Friday night's big Super 12 opener on the Oval, Hawke's Bay's Jarrod Cunningham is the hot tip to be wearing the Hurricanes' No 15 jersey.
All Black Christian Cullen is back putting on weight after his recent stomach infection but is still in the "highly unlikely" category for Friday, NZPA reports.
That was coach Frank Oliver's assessment yesterday without having seen Cullen since the Australian tour last week and subject to a doctor's examination.
"Christian hasn't touched a ball yet," said Oliver.
